operations.scientific_task: Reduce calibrated multispectral imagery to principal components with eigenvalues and band loadings.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoSpectralLinearUnmix fits supplied endmembers; PCA learns orthogonal variance directions without an endmember library.
operations.numeric_oracle: Four corners (0,0),(2,0),(0,4),(2,4) have unbiased covariance diag(4/3,16/3); the largest eigenvalue is 16/3.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate spectral noise covariance from horizontal adjacent-pixel differences in a declared homogeneous patch.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing spectral continuum and angle tools do not estimate sensor-noise cross-band covariance.
operations.numeric_oracle: Differences -1,+1,-1,+1 have sample variance 4/3; independent equal-variance pixel noise contributes half, 2/3.

operations.scientific_task: Reduce spectral dimensions after whitening by an explicitly supplied noise covariance.
operations.distinct_from_existing: PCA orders raw variance; MNF orders variance relative to measured noise. Existing spectral matching/unmixing does neither noise whitening nor MNF.
operations.numeric_oracle: Whitening diag(4/3,16/3) by noise diag(1,2) yields diag(4/3,8/3).

operations.scientific_task: Detect multivariate spectral anomalies relative to supplied background statistics.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoSpectralAngleMap compares reference directions; RX needs no target and measures squared background Mahalanobis distance.
operations.numeric_oracle: For x=(2,1), mean=0 and covariance diag(4,1), x^T C^-1 x=4/4+1=2.

operations.scientific_task: Map covariance-weighted linear responses to a supplied spectral target.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoSpectralLinearUnmix solves endmember coefficients; matched filtering uses an explicit background mean/covariance and one target, without interpreting coefficients as abundances.
operations.numeric_oracle: For target=(2,0), x=(2,1), mean=0 and C=diag(4,1), t^T C^-1 x / (t^T C^-1 t)=1.

operations.scientific_task: Map adaptive coherence scores for a supplied target in background-whitened spectral space.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoSpectralAngleMap is an unwhitened angle; ACE uses background covariance and squared normalized coherence, distinct from amplitude-sensitive matched filtering.
operations.numeric_oracle: Whitened target=(1,0) and pixel=(1,1) have squared cosine 1/(1*2)=1/2.

operations.scientific_task: Extract compact bright image features by white top-hat morphology at an explicit spatial scale.
operations.distinct_from_existing: RemoteSensingBatchHotspotRaster thresholds absolute brightness; top-hat measures brightness above a morphological local background.
operations.numeric_oracle: A single value 10 on uniform 2 has 3x3 opening 2 and white top-hat peak 10-2=8.

operations.scientific_task: Propagate supplied intensity seeds under a constraining image by grayscale geodesic reconstruction.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoMapColorExtract uses legend color distance; reconstruction follows connected intensity support from explicit seed evidence.
operations.numeric_oracle: A seed of 2 propagates across the connected 3x3 plateau of height 5 but cannot cross its zero boundary; plateau value is 2.

operations.scientific_task: Thin a supplied binary image feature mask to a one-pixel skeleton using Zhang thinning.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing cloud and hotspot masks classify pixels; skeletonization extracts the topology of supplied linear image features.
operations.numeric_oracle: An already one-pixel-wide isolated horizontal segment with 9 cells is a fixed point of topology-preserving thinning.

operations.scientific_task: Remove small connected detections by inclusive pixel-area threshold with four-neighbor connectivity.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing hotspot thresholding has no connected-area filtering; this rejects isolated detections based on spatial support.
operations.numeric_oracle: A 9-cell connected square survives max_size=1 while a disconnected singleton is removed.

operations.scientific_task: Fill small connected background gaps in a supplied binary detection mask.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Cloud masking excludes observations; hole filling edits supplied binary classification topology and does not reconstruct missing radiometry.
operations.numeric_oracle: A 3x3 foreground ring has a single-cell central background component; inclusive max_size=1 fills exactly one cell.

operations.scientific_task: Identify image maxima with a declared minimum intensity prominence.
operations.distinct_from_existing: RemoteSensingMaxValueAndIndex finds a global scalar maximum; h-maxima detects spatial prominence above surrounding image support.
operations.numeric_oracle: The isolated height-10 peak above background 2 has prominence 8>=3 and occupies one cell.

operations.scientific_task: Measure directional gray-level co-occurrence texture from explicitly quantized image intensities.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing batch means and hotspot percentages discard neighbor relationships; GLCM retains pairwise spatial texture at a declared lag.
operations.numeric_oracle: Horizontal neighbors of a binary checkerboard always differ by one; symmetric P01=P10=1/2, hence contrast=1.

operations.scientific_task: Map neighborhood Shannon entropy of explicitly quantized image intensities, excluding quality-mask pixels.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing scalar coefficient-of-variation and kurtosis tools do not map local histogram information content.
operations.numeric_oracle: At a straight image edge the truncated 2x3 checkerboard footprint contains three zeros and three ones, giving entropy 1 bit.

operations.scientific_task: Encode eight-neighbor local binary texture patterns on a supplied quantized image.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing optical indices compare spectral bands; LBP compares spatial neighbors with a center intensity to encode local texture.
operations.numeric_oracle: Inside a constant image all eight radius-one neighbors equal the center, so all bits are set: 2^8-1=255.

operations.scientific_task: Map image structure tensors and principal eigenvalues for directional fabric evidence.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoStereonetAnalysis uses supplied structural measurements; this estimates image-gradient anisotropy and does not infer geological strike/dip.
operations.numeric_oracle: For unit column ramp, the 3x3 Sobel derivative is 8 and row derivative is zero; the tensor eigenvalues are 64 and 0.

operations.scientific_task: Map real and imaginary responses to an oriented, band-limited Gabor texture filter.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GLCM measures quantized pairs; Gabor resolves signed local oscillation at a specified frequency and orientation, absent from baseline image tools.
operations.numeric_oracle: A unit impulse sampled at the center of a sigma_x=sigma_y=1 Gabor kernel has real response 1/(2*pi).

operations.scientific_task: Detect thin image boundaries using Gaussian smoothing, nonmaximum suppression and hysteresis.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing hotspot masks classify intensity; Canny detects connected gradient boundaries using two hysteresis thresholds.
operations.numeric_oracle: A 16x16 vertical unit step with sigma=0 has two equal Sobel-ridge columns; nonmaximum suppression keeps both on 14 interior rows: 28 cells.

operations.scientific_task: Derive an image threshold by maximizing between-class histogram variance and export its binary partition.
operations.distinct_from_existing: RemoteSensingBatchHotspotRaster uses a caller-fixed threshold; Otsu estimates the threshold from the observed histogram.
operations.numeric_oracle: Equal populations at integer DN=2 and 6 share the same optimal split for thresholds 2..5; the first maximizing bin is 2.

operations.scientific_task: Partition an image cost surface by flooding from explicit labeled markers.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoPyshedsFlowAccumulation is terrain hydrology; this is seeded image segmentation with arbitrary image costs, no drainage calculation.
operations.numeric_oracle: A connected 16x16 flat cost domain with a single marker is entirely reached by that seed: 256 cells.

operations.scientific_task: Create compact image superpixels using joint intensity and pixel-coordinate clustering.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoMapColorExtract matches legend colors to classes; SLIC forms unsupervised compact spatial support regions without semantic classes.
operations.numeric_oracle: One requested cluster on a connected constant 16x16 image assigns all 256 cells to one superpixel.

operations.scientific_task: Segment intensity imagery by graph edge weights and adaptive component merging.
operations.distinct_from_existing: SLIC imposes compact superpixels; graph segmentation follows intensity-edge component evidence without a requested region count, absent from the baseline.
operations.numeric_oracle: All graph edges of a constant connected 16x16 image have weight zero, so the positive-scale merge criterion combines all 256 cells.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate seeded class probabilities by solving an intensity-weighted image diffusion problem.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Watershed supplies hard flood labels; random walker solves a Dirichlet probability problem and exports per-class probability rasters, absent from baseline tools.
operations.numeric_oracle: On an 8x8 uniform-conductance grid seeded left=1 and right=2, p1(c)=1-c/7; summing gives 8*4=32.

operations.scientific_task: Measure pixel area, centroid, orientation and shape descriptors of supplied labeled image regions.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoShapelyGeometry measures vector geometry; this measures discrete labeled image regions and their intensity-independent shape moments.
operations.numeric_oracle: A labeled rectangle covering rows 2,3 and columns 2,3,4 contains 2*3=6 cells with centroid (2.5,3).

operations.scientific_task: Estimate translational alignment between two same-grid image patches using Fourier cross-correlation.
operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoRasterChangeAnalysis requires aligned imagery and only differences values; this estimates residual translation before change analysis.
operations.numeric_oracle: Moving impulse at (8,5) and reference at (6,6) require shift (-2,+1); with 30 m pixels map translation is (+30,+60) m.

operations.scientific_task: Map structural-similarity change between aligned acquisitions using an explicit intensity range and window.
operations.distinct_from_existing: RemoteSensingTiffDifference and GeoRasterChangeAnalysis use pixel subtraction; SSIM compares local luminance, contrast and structure.
operations.numeric_oracle: Constant a=.25,b=.5 with range=1 give SSIM=(2ab+.01^2)/(a^2+b^2+.01^2); variance terms cancel.

operations.scientific_task: Resample calibrated hyperspectral reflectance to explicit target sensor bands using Gaussian response-overlap integration.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Original SAM/continuum/unmixing tools compare or decompose spectra, and current PCA/MNF changes statistical basis; none integrates explicit source/target wavelength bandwidths. Spatial reprojection changes map coordinates, not spectral response. Unlike original SkdownscaleQuantileBiasCorrection, no empirical scene-distribution mapping is fitted.
operations.numeric_oracle: Source intervals [950,1050] and [1050,1150] nm partition a target Gaussian centered at 1050 nm with FWHM 200 nm into equal halves. Symmetry gives weights 1/2,1/2; reflectances .2,.6 therefore yield .4, independently of the upstream implementation.

operations.scientific_task: Denoise image radiometry with Chambolle total-variation regularization.
operations.distinct_from_existing: RemoteSensingTiffAverage averages acquisitions; TV regularizes spatial gradients within one image and does not require temporal repeats.
operations.numeric_oracle: A constant .5 field has zero total variation and is the exact minimizer of the nonnegative ROF objective; every output pixel remains .5.

operations.scientific_task: Restore spatial blur by Richardson-Lucy iterations with an explicitly supplied normalized point-spread function.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing image previews and difference tools do not invert a supplied instrument point-spread function.
operations.numeric_oracle: An identity PSF leaves the row ramp .2+.01*c unchanged; c=0..15 has mean 7.5, giving .275 (tolerance allows upstream epsilon).

operations.scientific_task: Estimate a smooth image background with a rolling-ball intensity surface and export background plus residual.
operations.distinct_from_existing: White top-hat uses a flat morphological footprint; rolling ball uses a curved nonflat intensity surface to estimate spatial background, absent from baseline calibration.
operations.numeric_oracle: For a constant field 4, the ball tangent at its center yields background exactly 4; no lower background candidate exists.
